resources.string: Patches the official Emby for Android app so it loads the Discover Media plugin. Choose your device, then download and patch.
ARMv7 – Android TV, TV boxes and older phones
Fire TV – Amazon Fire TV and Fire tablets
Use an APK I already have…
Uninstall the official Emby app once first: the patched app is signed with this app\'s own key. Later Emby updates patched on this device install over it.
Patching and signing … (this can take a minute)
Allow this app to install apps, then tap Install again.
This does not look like the Emby for Android app (phone/tablet version). The separate Android TV app cannot be patched.
